Manage roles

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/Access-Control](https://docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/Access-Control)
:::

```sh
bronto roles <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto roles create`](/reference/commands/roles/#bronto-roles-create) | Create a role |
| [`bronto roles delete`](/reference/commands/roles/#bronto-roles-delete) | Delete a role |
| [`bronto roles get`](/reference/commands/roles/#bronto-roles-get) | Get a role by ID |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto roles create

Create a role

```sh
bronto roles create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | request body field as key=value; values parse as JSON when possible (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | read the request body from a file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto roles create -f name=<name>
bronto roles create --input body.json
```
